sentences.l2: 部屋のたなの上に、青いセーターを着たクマのおもちゃがいます。
sentences.l1: On a shelf in the room, there is a toy bear wearing a blue sweater.

sentences.l2: 体はふわふわで、さわるととてもやわらかいです。
sentences.l1: Its body is fluffy, and it is very soft to the touch.

sentences.l2: このセーターは、持ち主の女の子のおばあさんが作ってくれました。
sentences.l1: This sweater was made for her by the grandmother of the girl who owns it.

sentences.l2: 女の子は毎晩このクマをだいてねるので、さむい冬でも安心できるそうです。
sentences.l1: The girl hugs this bear and sleeps every night, so she reportedly feels safe even in the cold winter.
